newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain can create more new jobs - Aznar.
newsitem.headline: Spain can create more new jobs - Aznar.

text.p: Spain's Prime Minister reiterated on Thursday that the economy is currently in a condition to generate new jobs.
In a interview published by Italian financial newspaper Il Sole 24 ore, Jose Maria Aznar said Spain never had such good economic results as at present.

"Never has it happened that (Spain) had so many good data...This year we are not only respecting forecasts, but the actual data are better, and this is after the Bank of Spain has improved its forecasts twice," Aznar told the newspaper.
Regarding employment, he added: "The Spanish economy is currently in a virtuous circle, and in condition to create new jobs. If this growth continues, possibilities will increase."
